ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient acquisition and trust engine specifically built for international clinics and prosthodontic/orthopedic cross-border care.
ideas.problem_statement: EthAum Medical Tourism Hackathon: Build an AI-Powered International Healthcare Marketplace
ideas.title: GlobalSmile Health Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts a proven 1st-place winning architecture (Global-Smile) directly to the medical tourism marketplace track, giving judges a rock-solid, production-ready frontend and AI pipeline.

ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade medical record organizer and multi-language symptom triage tool that standardizes patient files before sending them to international hospitals.
ideas.problem_statement: EthAum Medical Tourism Hackathon: Build an AI-Powered International Healthcare Marketplace
ideas.title: MediScan Cross-Border Triage & Records
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the multi-language triage and medical data management patterns from a top-2 winner, directly solving the document organization and record-sharing friction for patients.

ideas.pitch: An AI-assisted telehealth and video simulation portal that helps patients prepare for virtual consultations with international specialists using rubric-scored interview guides.
ideas.problem_statement: EthAum Medical Tourism Hackathon: Build an AI-Powered International Healthcare Marketplace
ideas.title: Clinical-Sim Virtual Consult & Prep
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies award-winning camera and audio interaction tech to virtual consultations, ensuring clear diagnostic handoffs between patients and overseas doctors.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent AI system that evaluates international hospital treatment quotes and insurance estimates for markup bias, hidden fees, and treatment discrepancies.
ideas.problem_statement: EthAum Medical Tourism Hackathon: Build an AI-Powered International Healthcare Marketplace
ideas.title: ClaimBias Medical Quote Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Translates a 1st-place multi-agent auditing pattern into quote comparison, addressing the massive consumer trust and cost transparency problem in medical tourism.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven post-treatment recovery and aftercare coordinator that predicts complication risks and coordinates follow-ups between foreign providers and local doctors.
ideas.problem_statement: EthAum Medical Tourism Hackathon: Build an AI-Powered International Healthcare Marketplace
ideas.title: ReadmitGuard Recovery & Aftercare Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses high-accuracy predictive modelling and clinical explainability (SHAP) to solve the critical aftercare gap that medical tourism platforms traditionally ignore.
